_why: One action of a gallery recipe crosses two independent whitelists - PHP on its way out of validation, JavaScript on its way into the browser - and neither can read the other. This file is what they agree on. Adding a field to the contract fails the PHP test until the validation rules declare it and the JS test until the runner keeps it, so a field can no longer be asked for in the prompt, accepted by the rules and silently dropped before the browser ever sees it.
